coffee.title: Заказ в Кофейне
coffee.screenplay: Закажите свой любимый напиток, спросите о размерах и добавках, подтвердите общую сумму и заберите кофе на стойке.

chat.briefing: Привет! Сегодня мы будем практиковаться в заказе в кофейне — приветствие, размеры, добавки. Сначала я немного объясню, а потом мы разыграем. Звучит хорошо?
chat.incoming1: Добро пожаловать! Чем могу помочь вам сегодня?
chat.outgoing1: Привет! Я хотел бы средний латте, пожалуйста.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Хотите горячий или холодный, и какие-то добавки?
chat.botReply: Отличный выбор. Что-то еще к вашему заказу?

coffeeQueue.title: Waiting in the Coffee Line
coffeeQueue.screenplay: Stand in line at a busy café, chat politely with the person ahead of you, hold your spot, and get ready to order when it's your turn.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice waiting in a coffee line — small talk, holding your place, and moving up. I'll explain a little first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: This line is moving slowly today, huh?
chat.outgoing1: Yeah — mornings are always busy here.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Are you getting the usual, or trying something new?
chat.botReply: Nice. Looks like you're next — good luck with your order!

coffeeRecommendation.title: Asking for a Drink Recommendation
coffeeRecommendation.screenplay: Ask the barista what they recommend, compare a few drinks, choose size and milk options, then place your order confidently.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking a barista for recommendations — flavors, sizes, milk options. I'll explain a little first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hey! Need a suggestion, or do you already know what you want?
chat.outgoing1: I'd love a recommendation — something not too bitter.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Our honey oat latte is popular, or the caramel cold brew if you want iced.
chat.botReply: Great pick. What size should I make that?

coffeeWrongOrder.title: Fixing a Wrong Coffee Order
coffeeWrongOrder.screenplay: Politely explain that your drink is wrong, describe what you ordered, ask for a remake or swap, and thank the barista.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice fixing a wrong coffee order — staying polite, explaining the mistake, and asking for a remake. I'll teach a few phrases first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Here's your order — medium iced latte. Enjoy!
chat.outgoing1: Sorry, I think this might be wrong. I asked for a hot oat milk latte.
chat.incoming2Rest: — my mistake! I'll remake that for you right away.
chat.botReply: Thanks for your patience. Hot oat milk latte coming up.

directions.title: Спросить Направление на Улице
directions.screenplay: Спросите направление к месту, узнайте, как добраться до метро или автобуса, получите информацию о билетах и послушайте рекомендации по ресторанам.

chat.briefing: Привет! Сегодня мы будем практиковаться в том, как спрашивать направление на улице. Сначала я немного объясню, а потом мы разыграем. Звучит хорошо?
chat.incoming1: Привет! Вы выглядите немного потерянным — нужна помощь с поиском чего-то?
chat.outgoing1: Да, я ищу ближайшую станцию метро.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Идите два квартала в ту сторону, затем поверните налево. Вы увидите вход.
chat.botReply: Пожалуйста! Хотите совет по ресторану рядом со станцией?

directionsWrongWay.title: Correcting Wrong Directions
directionsWrongWay.screenplay: Realize the directions were wrong, politely check again, and get clearer landmark-based instructions.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice fixing wrong directions politely. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Did you find the park?
chat.outgoing1: I think I went the wrong way. Could you explain it again with landmarks?
chat.incoming2Rest: — walk past the red bookstore, then left at the fountain.
chat.botReply: If you see the bakery, you've gone too far.

directionsTransit.title: Asking About Bus or Subway Routes
directionsTransit.screenplay: Ask which line to take, how many stops, and where to transfer to reach your destination.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking about bus and subway routes. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Need transit help?
chat.outgoing1: Yes — which subway line goes to the museum?
chat.incoming2Rest: three stops, then transfer to the green line.
chat.botReply: The whole trip is about twenty minutes.

directionsLost.title: Asking for Help When You're Lost
directionsLost.screenplay: Admit you're lost, describe where you need to go, and confirm the directions before you leave.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking for help when you're lost. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: You look a little lost — need a hand?
chat.outgoing1: Yes, please. I'm trying to find City Hall.
chat.incoming2Rest: — go straight two blocks, then turn right.
chat.botReply: Want me to point it out on the map too?

interview.title: Собеседование
interview.screenplay: Представьтесь, ответьте на общие вопросы собеседования, расскажите о своем опыте и спросите о роли и следующих шагах.

chat.briefing: Привет! Сегодня мы будем практиковаться в собеседовании. Сначала я немного объясню, а потом мы разыграем — я буду вас интервьюировать, а потом мы поменяемся. Звучит хорошо?
chat.incoming1: Спасибо, что пришли сегодня. Можете кратко представиться?
chat.outgoing1: Конечно. Я рад быть здесь и поделиться своим опытом.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Расскажите о недавнем проекте, которым вы гордитесь.
chat.botReply: Это впечатляет. Какие у вас есть вопросы о роли?

interviewSalary.title: Discussing Salary Expectations
interviewSalary.screenplay: Talk about salary range politely, ask about benefits, and keep the tone professional.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice discussing salary expectations professionally. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: What are your salary expectations for this role?
chat.outgoing1: I'm looking for a range around market average for this level. Could you share your band?
chat.incoming2Rest: . Benefits also include remote days and learning budget.
chat.botReply: Are benefits important in your decision?

interviewExperience.title: Describing Work Experience
interviewExperience.screenplay: Walk through a recent role, your responsibilities, and one achievement with numbers if possible.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice describing work experience clearly. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Tell me about your most recent role.
chat.outgoing1: I coordinated a small team and improved our delivery time.
chat.incoming2Rest: . By how much did you improve it?
chat.botReply: What was the hardest part of that job?

interviewStrengths.title: Talking About Your Strengths
interviewStrengths.screenplay: Describe two strengths with short examples and connect them to the job.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about your strengths in an interview. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: What would you say are your biggest strengths?
chat.outgoing1: I'm organized and I communicate clearly with teammates.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Can you give a quick example?
chat.botReply: How do those strengths help in this role?

missedTrain.title: You Missed Your Train
missedTrain.screenplay: You missed your train and ask a station staff member for help — explain where you're going, find the next train, and get directions to the platform.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice what to say when you miss your train at a station. I'll teach a few phrases first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Hello, where are you trying to go?
chat.outgoing1: I need to get to Manchester. I think I missed my 10:15 train.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Let me check the next available train for you.
chat.botReply: Would you prefer the fastest option or the cheapest one?

missedTrainRefund.title: Asking About Rebooking or a Refund
missedTrainRefund.screenplay: Ask about rebooking, refunds, or compensation after missing a connection due to a delay.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking about rebooking or refunds after a missed train. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: How can I help?
chat.outgoing1: My first train was delayed and I missed the connection. Can I rebook for free?
chat.incoming2Rest: — I'll put you on the next available train.
chat.botReply: Would you like an email confirmation too?

missedTrainTicket.title: Fixing a Ticket After Missing a Train
missedTrainTicket.screenplay: Ask whether your ticket is still valid, if you can board the next train, and what to do at the gate.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice fixing ticket issues after missing a train. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Ticket problems?
chat.outgoing1: I missed my train. Is this ticket still valid for the next one?
chat.incoming2Rest: for the next two hours on the same route.
chat.botReply: Just show it at the gate — you're fine.

missedTrainNext.title: Finding the Next Train
missedTrainNext.screenplay: Explain you missed your train and ask when the next one leaves and which platform to use.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice finding the next train after missing yours. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Can I help you?
chat.outgoing1: I just missed the 10:15 to Boston. When's the next one?
chat.incoming2Rest: from platform 3.
chat.botReply: Do you need help with the ticket gate?

flightAttendant.title: Talking to a Flight Attendant
flightAttendant.screenplay: You're a passenger on a flight. Find your seat, get help with luggage, choose food and drinks, and ask for anything you need during the flight.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking to a flight attendant on a plane — seats, luggage, meals. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hello! May I see your boarding pass, please?
chat.outgoing1: Sure, here you go. I'm in seat 14B.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Would you like some help finding your seat?
chat.botReply: Would you like something to drink — water, juice, coffee, or tea?

flightDelay.title: Asking About a Delay or Connection
flightDelay.screenplay: Ask why the flight is delayed, whether you'll make a connection, and what help is available.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking about delays and connections on a flight. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: We'll be delayed about forty minutes.
chat.outgoing1: I have a tight connection. Will I still make it?
chat.incoming2Rest: . I'll radio ahead if needed.
chat.botReply: Do you need gate information for the next flight?

flightSpecialMeal.title: Asking for a Special Meal
flightSpecialMeal.screenplay: Ask about meal options, request vegetarian or other special meals, and confirm timing.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking for a special meal on a flight. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: We're serving dinner soon.
chat.outgoing1: Do you have a vegetarian option?
chat.incoming2Rest: — pasta or salad box.
chat.botReply: I'll bring it with the next cart.

flightSeat.title: Asking to Change Seats
flightSeat.screenplay: Politely ask if you can switch seats for comfort, family, or a window/aisle preference.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking a flight attendant to change seats. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Need anything before takeoff?
chat.outgoing1: Could I move to an aisle seat if one is free?
chat.incoming2Rest: … yes, 14C is open.
chat.botReply: I'll move your bag tag too.

trainTicket.title: Buying a Train Ticket
trainTicket.screenplay: At a train station, tell the clerk where you're going, pick a departure time, choose ticket type and seat, and pay for your ticket.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice buying a train ticket at the counter. I'll teach useful phrases first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Hello! Where would you like to go?
chat.outgoing1: I'd like to go to Edinburgh, please.
chat.incoming2Rest: . When would you like to travel?
chat.botReply: Would you like a one-way or return ticket?

trainTicketUpgrade.title: Upgrading Your Seat or Class
trainTicketUpgrade.screenplay: Ask about upgrading to quiet car or first class, compare prices, and complete the change.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice upgrading a train seat or class. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Need help with your ticket?
chat.outgoing1: Can I upgrade to first class on this train?
chat.incoming2Rest: — seats are open for an extra forty dollars.
chat.botReply: Quiet car is cheaper if you prefer that.

trainTicketPlatform.title: Finding the Right Platform
trainTicketPlatform.screenplay: Ask which platform your train leaves from and how to get there with luggage.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice finding the right train platform. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Looking for your platform?
chat.outgoing1: Yes — the train to Chicago. Which platform is it?
chat.incoming2Rest: . Elevators are on the left.
chat.botReply: Boarding starts in ten minutes.

trainTicketChange.title: Changing Your Train Ticket Time
trainTicketChange.screenplay: Ask to change departure time, check fees, and confirm the new ticket.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice changing a train ticket time. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Ticket desk — how can I help?
chat.outgoing1: Can I change my 3 pm ticket to the 5 pm train?
chat.incoming2Rest: , with a small change fee.
chat.botReply: I'll print the updated ticket now.

restaurantReservation.title: Making a Restaurant Reservation
restaurantReservation.screenplay: Call or visit a restaurant to book a table — choose the date, time, number of guests, seating preference, and confirm your reservation.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice making a restaurant reservation. I'll explain a few phrases first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hello! How can I help you?
chat.outgoing1: Hi, I'd like to make a reservation for dinner, please.
chat.incoming2Rest: . What day would you like to come?
chat.botReply: How many people will be joining you?

restaurantComplaint.title: Complaining Politely at a Restaurant
restaurantComplaint.screenplay: Explain a problem with food or service calmly and ask for a fair fix.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice complaining politely at a restaurant. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Is everything alright with your meal?
chat.outgoing1: The pasta is cold. Could you remake it, please?
chat.incoming2Rest: — we'll remake it right away.
chat.botReply: Would you like a drink while you wait?

restaurantAllergy.title: Talking About Food Allergies
restaurantAllergy.screenplay: Explain allergies or diet needs, ask what's safe on the menu, and confirm with the staff.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about food allergies at a restaurant. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?

chat.outgoing1: Yes — I'm allergic to peanuts. Which dishes are safe?

chat.botReply: Would you like the chef's recommendation?

restaurantChange.title: Changing a Restaurant Reservation
restaurantChange.screenplay: Call to change the time or party size and confirm the new details.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice changing a restaurant reservation. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Reservation desk, how can I help?
chat.outgoing1: I have a booking for 7. Can we move it to 8 for four people?
chat.incoming2Rest: , 8 pm for four is available.

doctorAppointment.title: Making a Doctor's Appointment
doctorAppointment.screenplay: Call a clinic to book a doctor's appointment — explain why you need to visit, choose a day and time, and confirm your details.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice making a doctor's appointment by phone. I'll teach key phrases first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Hello! How can I help you today?
chat.outgoing1: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment with a doctor, please.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Have you visited our clinic before?

doctorFollowUp.screenplay: Ask what results mean, next steps, and whether you need another appointment.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about test results with a doctor. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?

chat.outgoing1: What do they mean? Do I need more tests?

doctorPrescription.title: Asking About Medicine
doctorPrescription.screenplay: Ask how to take medicine, about side effects, and when to come back if it doesn't help.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking about medicine and prescriptions. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: I'm giving you this medicine twice a day.
chat.outgoing1: Should I take it with food? Any side effects?
chat.incoming2Rest: , with food. Mild drowsiness is possible.
chat.botReply: If it doesn't help in three days, call us.

doctorSymptoms.title: Describing Your Symptoms
doctorSymptoms.screenplay: Explain what hurts, when it started, and how strong the pain is.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice describing symptoms at a doctor's appointment. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: What brings you in today?
chat.outgoing1: I've had a sore throat for three days.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Any fever or cough?
chat.botReply: On a scale of one to ten, how bad is the pain?

shoppingClothes.title: Shopping for Clothes
shoppingClothes.screenplay: In a clothing store, tell the assistant what you're looking for, try items on, compare sizes and colors, and decide whether to buy.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice shopping for clothes in a store. I'll explain useful phrases first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hello! Can I help you find something?
chat.outgoing1: Yes, I'm looking for a casual shirt for everyday wear.
chat.incoming2Rest: . What size do you usually wear?
chat.botReply: Would you prefer something casual or more formal?

shoppingDiscount.title: Asking About a Discount
shoppingDiscount.screenplay: Ask about sales, student discounts, or price matches, then decide whether the deal is worth it.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking about discounts and sales. I'll teach a few phrases first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: That jacket looks great on you!
chat.outgoing1: Thanks! Is it on sale, or do you have any discounts today?
chat.incoming2Rest: , there's 20% off if you buy two items.
chat.botReply: Student discount is also available with ID.

shoppingReturn.title: Returning an Item to the Store
shoppingReturn.screenplay: Return a purchase politely — explain the reason, show the receipt, and ask for a refund or exchange.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice returning an item — being polite, explaining why, and asking for a refund. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hi! How can I help you today?
chat.outgoing1: I'd like to return this shirt. It doesn't fit well.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Do you have the receipt with you?
chat.botReply: Would you prefer a refund or an exchange?

shoppingFittingRoom.title: Trying Clothes in the Fitting Room
shoppingFittingRoom.screenplay: Ask for a different size, check the mirror, and decide whether to buy the outfit.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice in a fitting room — sizes, colors, and deciding to buy. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: How's that size working for you?
chat.outgoing1: It's a bit tight. Do you have a larger size?
chat.incoming2Rest: ! I'll grab the next size for you.
chat.botReply: Want to try another color while I check?

takingTaxi.title: Taking a Taxi
takingTaxi.screenplay: Get in a taxi in a new city, tell the driver where you're going, talk about the route, and pay at the end of the ride.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice taking a taxi — giving your destination, chatting with the driver, and paying. I'll teach first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Hello! Where would you like to go?
chat.outgoing1: The Grand Hotel on Park Street, please.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Do you have the exact address?
chat.botReply: Would you prefer the fastest route?

taxiComplaint.title: Handling a Taxi Problem
taxiComplaint.screenplay: Politely raise an issue — wrong route, AC, or fare — and ask for a fair solution.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice handling a problem in a taxi politely. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: We're almost there.
chat.outgoing1: Sorry, but this isn't the address I gave. Can we fix that?
chat.incoming2Rest: — my mistake. I'll turn around right away.
chat.botReply: Thanks for telling me. No extra charge.

taxiTraffic.title: Talking About Traffic and Routes
taxiTraffic.screenplay: Discuss traffic, ask for a faster route, and decide whether to wait or take another way.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about traffic and alternate routes in a taxi. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Traffic is heavy on the highway.
chat.outgoing1: Is there a faster route through the city?
chat.incoming2Rest: , but there are more lights. It might still be quicker.
chat.botReply: Want me to take the city route?

taxiFare.title: Asking About the Taxi Fare
taxiFare.screenplay: Ask for an estimate before the ride, confirm payment options, and check the final amount at the end.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking about taxi fares. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Where to?
chat.outgoing1: To the airport, please. About how much will it cost?
chat.incoming2Rest: , depending on traffic.
chat.botReply: Card and cash are both fine.

rentingApartment.title: Renting an Apartment
rentingApartment.screenplay: Talk to a landlord about a rental apartment — ask about rent, bills, deposit, pets, parking, and arrange a viewing.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking to a landlord about renting an apartment. I'll explain key phrases first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hello! Are you interested in renting the apartment?
chat.outgoing1: Yes, I'd like to know more about it, please.
chat.incoming2Rest: . When are you looking to move in?
chat.botReply: Do you need a furnished or unfurnished apartment?

rentingApartmentNegotiate.title: Negotiating Rent and Lease Terms
rentingApartmentNegotiate.screenplay: Negotiate rent, deposit, move-in date, and pet policy politely while staying clear about your limits.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice negotiating rent and lease terms. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: The rent is thirteen hundred plus utilities.
chat.outgoing1: Could you do twelve fifty if I sign a longer lease?
chat.incoming2Rest: for a 18-month lease. Deposit is still one month.
chat.botReply: Are pets allowed with an extra fee?

rentingApartmentAgent.title: Talking with a Real Estate Agent
rentingApartmentAgent.screenplay: Talk to an agent about budget, location, lease length, and which listings match your needs.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking with a real estate agent about rentals. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: What kind of apartment are you looking for?
chat.outgoing1: A one-bedroom near the subway, under twelve hundred a month.
chat.incoming2Rest: . I have three options in that range.
chat.botReply: Do you prefer furnished or unfurnished?

rentingApartmentTour.title: Talking About the Apartment on a Tour
rentingApartmentTour.screenplay: Ask about rooms, sunlight, noise, appliances, and whether furniture is included during a viewing.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about an apartment during a viewing. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Here's the living room — what do you think?
chat.outgoing1: It's nice. Does it get much sunlight in the afternoon?
chat.incoming2Rest: , especially from these windows.
chat.botReply: Want to see the kitchen and balcony next?

birthdayParty.title: Planning a Birthday Party
birthdayParty.screenplay: Plan a birthday party with a friend — pick the venue, date, guest list, food, cake, music, and activities together.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice planning a birthday party with a friend. I'll teach useful phrases first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: So, whose birthday are we planning?
chat.outgoing1: It's for my friend Emma — her birthday is next month.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! When should we have the party?
chat.botReply: Would you rather have the party at home or at a restaurant?

birthdaySurprise.title: Planning a Surprise Party
birthdaySurprise.screenplay: Keep the surprise secret, assign tasks, and handle last-minute changes without spoiling it.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice planning a surprise party without spoiling it. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Is everything ready for the surprise?
chat.outgoing1: Almost — can you distract her until 7?
chat.incoming2Rest: . What if she finishes work early?
chat.botReply: Text me and I'll stall with coffee.

birthdayGifts.title: Talking About Birthday Gifts
birthdayGifts.screenplay: Discuss gift ideas, budget, and whether to buy something together.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about birthday gifts. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: What should we get for Emma?
chat.outgoing1: Maybe a book or headphones. What's our budget?
chat.incoming2Rest: each if we go together.
chat.botReply: Want to shop online or in store?

birthdayInvite.title: Inviting Guests to a Party
birthdayInvite.screenplay: Invite friends, share the date and place, and ask who can come.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice inviting guests to a birthday party. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: What's up?
chat.outgoing1: I'm hosting a birthday party on Saturday. Can you come?
chat.incoming2Rest: ! What time does it start?
chat.botReply: Should I bring anything?

flirtingMeet.title: Meeting Someone New at a Café
flirtingMeet.screenplay: Strike up a friendly conversation, share a little about yourself, exchange interests, and decide whether to meet again.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice a light flirting conversation at a café — hellos, compliments, and asking for a number. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?

flirtingAwkward.title: Handling an Awkward Moment
flirtingAwkward.screenplay: Recover from a misunderstanding or awkward pause, apologize lightly, and steer the chat back to a comfortable topic.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice handling an awkward moment in a flirty chat — light apology and recovery. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?

chat.outgoing1: Oh no — sorry! That was embarrassing. Can we start over?
chat.incoming2Rest: . I'm Maya.

flirtingAskOut.title: Asking Someone Out
flirtingAskOut.screenplay: After a short chat, suggest meeting again — coffee, a walk, or a movie — and handle a yes or a soft no gracefully.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking someone out politely. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: I've really enjoyed talking with you.
chat.outgoing1: Me too. Would you like to grab coffee sometime this week?
chat.incoming2Rest: . What day works for you?
chat.botReply: Saturday afternoon is free for me.

flirtingCompliment.title: Giving a Friendly Compliment
flirtingCompliment.screenplay: Start with a light compliment, keep it respectful, and see if the other person wants to keep talking.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice giving a friendly compliment — short, kind, and natural. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Oh, excuse me — I almost bumped into you.
chat.outgoing1: No worries! By the way, I like your jacket.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! That's sweet of you to say.
chat.botReply: Are you waiting for someone, or just hanging out?

freeTalkHobby.title: Talking About Hobbies
freeTalkHobby.screenplay: Chat freely about free-time activities, ask follow-up questions, share preferences, and suggest trying something new together.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice free discussion about hobbies — asking, answering, and reacting naturally. I'll explain first, then we'll talk. Ready?
chat.incoming1: So, what do you usually do on weekends?
chat.outgoing1: I like hiking and watching films. How about you?
chat.incoming2Rest: ! I've been meaning to try hiking more. Any favorite trails?
chat.botReply: That sounds perfect. Want to go together sometime?

freeTalkDisagree.title: Politely Disagreeing About Hobbies
freeTalkDisagree.screenplay: Disagree politely about a hobby preference, explain your view, and keep the conversation friendly.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice disagreeing politely about hobbies. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: I think hiking is boring.
chat.outgoing1: I get that — for me it's relaxing. What do you prefer instead?
chat.incoming2Rest: . I like indoor climbing more.
chat.botReply: Maybe we can try each other's hobby once.

freeTalkMovies.title: Talking About Movies
freeTalkMovies.screenplay: Recommend a movie, ask about genres, and react to each other's favorites.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about movies — genres, favorites, recommendations. I'll explain first, then we'll chat. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Seen any good movies lately?
chat.outgoing1: Yes — a comedy last week. Do you like comedies?
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Any titles you'd recommend?
chat.botReply: I'll send you my top three tonight.

freeTalkWeekend.screenplay: Share weekend plans, ask about theirs, and suggest a simple activity you could do together.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice chatting about weekend plans. I'll explain first, then we'll talk. Sound good?

chat.outgoing1: I might go to the park. What about you?

chat.botReply: Want to meet for a short walk on Sunday?

supportedLanguages.question: Какие языки поддерживает приложение?
supportedLanguages.answer: Интерфейс Lingola доступен на английском, немецком, итальянском, французском, турецком, японском, испанском, русском, хинди, португальском и упрощённом китайском языках.

howAiWorks.question: Как работает ИИ?
howAiWorks.answer: ИИ взаимодействует с тобой как настоящий репетитор. Он анализирует твои разговоры, выявляет ошибки и предлагает персонализированную обратную связь на основе твоего прогресса.

offlineUse.question: Могу ли я использовать приложение офлайн?
offlineUse.answer: Да. Ты можешь заранее скачать определенные уроки и сценарии разговоров и использовать их офлайн. Однако для живого чата требуется интернет-соединение.

isFree.question: Приложение бесплатное?
isFree.answer: Базовая версия бесплатна. С Премиум ты получаешь расширенные сценарии чата, анализ произношения и режим личного репетитора.

pronunciationEval.question: Как оценивается мое произношение?
pronunciationEval.answer: Приложение анализирует твой голос и использует распознавание речи на основе ИИ, чтобы оценить твой акцент и произношение. Слова, которые нужно улучшить, выделяются.

dailyPractice.question: Мне нужно практиковаться каждый день?
dailyPractice.answer: Да. Система отслеживает твой прогресс каждый день. Всего 10–15 минут практики разговорной речи в день могут значительно ускорить твое изучение языка.

levelDetermination.question: Как определяется мой уровень обучения?
levelDetermination.answer: Краткая проверка уровня при первом входе анализирует твои текущие знания. После этого ИИ автоматически рекомендует уроки, подходящие твоему уровню.

realPeopleChat.question: Могу ли я общаться с реальными людьми?
realPeopleChat.answer: Да. Пользователи Премиум могут планировать короткие практические сессии с реальными репетиторами.

dataSecurity.question: Безопасны ли мои данные?
dataSecurity.answer: Абсолютно. Все разговоры и данные пользователей хранятся в зашифрованном виде. Твоя личная информация никогда не передается третьим лицам.

disableReminders.question: Как отключить ежедневные напоминания?
disableReminders.answer: Перейди в настройки профиля, открой Уведомления и измени частоту напоминаний или полностью отключи уведомления.
